experiences.title: AI and Data Science Engineer II
experiences.description: Designed and developed a centralized AI-powered business intelligence and partner discovery platform that helps Deloitte identify, evaluate, and qualify U.S. small businesses for large project opportunities. The platform fuses 250+ GB of government spending data, internal organizational intelligence, and real-time web sources into a continuously enriched knowledge system — cutting manual research from hours to minutes through a multi-agent AI assistant.
keyFeatures: U.S. Spending Data Pipeline: Ingested and processed 100+ GB of U.S. government spending data using GCP Cloud Storage, PostgreSQL, and BigQuery, with automated filtering and transformation of relevant datasets at scale

Organization Intelligence Pipeline: Built a separate enrichment pipeline collecting and structuring data from websites, social media, internal sources, and public datasets for every newly onboarded organization
LLM-Based Data Processing: Applied LLMs to understand, clean, validate, and normalize unstructured business information — improving downstream data quality and consistency across the knowledge base

Structured + Semantic Knowledge Layer: Automatically transformed processed data into semantic chunks for Vector DB and structured attributes for BigQuery, enabling both RAG-based and analytical querying from a single pipeline

Persistent Reusable Knowledge Base: Built an enrichment-once, query-always architecture — existing internal knowledge is used first and only missing or outdated data is fetched externally, reducing repetitive organization research by 60–70%

Multi-Agent AI Assistant: Developed a LangGraph-based multi-agent system with specialized tools querying BigQuery, Vector DB, internal data, and live web sources — combining results to answer complex business questions in a single response

Rich Business Intelligence Output: Assistant generates contextual explanations, structured data tables, summaries, and visual representations tailored to each user query, enabling teams to evaluate hundreds of organizations through one centralized workflow

Automated Onboarding Workflow: Submitting a business name and website automatically triggers the full enrichment pipeline — from data collection through LLM processing, structured storage, and vector indexing — cutting research turnaround from hours to minutes for previously indexed businesses
Enterprise Application: Built on FastAPI, React, WebSockets, GCP, Docker, and Nginx — supporting real-time streaming interaction and production-grade scalable deployment across the full platform
